items.title: ConocoPhillips Fuels Up for Record Closing High
items.summary: ConocoPhillips is on track to hit an all-time closing high, based on data going back to 1972. The oil and natural gas company's shares are currently hovering around $135, up less than 0.1%. This would be the company's first new record closing high since November 2022.
